title: Handwritten Entry Transcription Throughput
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:journal journal_name=* pages_transcribed=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(pages_transcribed) as metric by _time journal_name
| sort 0 _time journal_name
description: Trends monthly pages transcribed by journal for handwritten-journal transcription.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether handwritten-journal transcription are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `journal_name` on `memory:journal` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly pages transcribed.
visualization: Line chart of monthly pages transcribed by journal.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how pages transcribed changes month by month for each journal so you can see whether handwritten-journal transcription are heading the right way.
